name: gaze-agent
description: Gaze-to-Agent: a gaze-first accessibility interface that lets a motor-impaired user communicate intent with their eyes and delegate computer work to an AI agent.
author: View

scripts.agent:live: npm run build && GAZE_PROVIDER=webeyetrack SIMULATE_GAZE=false FORCE_CALIBRATION=false ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_GAZE=true EXECUTOR_PROVIDER=openai EXECUTION_MODE=live DEBUG_HUD=false electron-vite preview 2>&1 | tee /tmp/view-live.log
scripts.demo:simulate: npm run build && GAZE_PROVIDER=simulated SIMULATE_GAZE=true CONTEXT_IN_SIMULATION=true DECODER_PROVIDER=openrouter DECODER_MODEL=deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 EXECUTOR_PROVIDER=openai EXECUTION_MODE=live DEBUG_HUD=false electron-vite preview 2>&1 | tee /tmp/view-simulated.log
scripts.demo:calibrate: npm run build && GAZE_PROVIDER=webeyetrack SIMULATE_GAZE=false FORCE_CALIBRATION=false DEBUG_HUD=false electron-vite preview 2>&1 | tee /tmp/view-calibration.log
scripts.demo:gaze-unverified: npm run build && GAZE_PROVIDER=webeyetrack SIMULATE_GAZE=false FORCE_CALIBRATION=false ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_GAZE=true DEBUG_HUD=false electron-vite preview 2>&1 | tee /tmp/view-calibration.log
scripts.demo:recalibrate: npm run build && GAZE_PROVIDER=webeyetrack SIMULATE_GAZE=false FORCE_CALIBRATION=true DEBUG_HUD=false electron-vite preview 2>&1 | tee /tmp/view-calibration.log
